content: 1. Engaging in and challenging maladaptive thoughts can help individuals address unhelpful cognitive patterns. 2. Distraction involves focusing attention on other stimuli to divert from unhelpful thoughts. 3. Self-talk refers to using self-instruction and self-encouragement to support positive actions. 4. Self-praise is the act of boosting one’s self-esteem by expressing approval or admiration for oneself. 5. Mood monitoring involves paying attention to one’s emotional states using various methods. 6. Mindfulness is the practice of focusing on present experiences within the body and mind while accepting events as they occur. 7. Self-awareness is the conscious recognition of oneself as the object of one’s own awareness. 8. Aerobic exercises, also known as cardio, include activities such as running, swimming, walking, hiking, aerobics classes, dancing, cross-country skiing, and kickboxing. 9. Non-aerobic or anaerobic exercises involve physical activities that quickly cause shortness of breath, such as sprinting or lifting heavy weights. 10. Motivational enhancement aims to increase internal motivation to facilitate long-lasting behavioral changes. 11. Praise involves recognizing and commending positive behaviors or accomplishments. 12. Role-playing entails acting out the role of a person in a specific situation to practice or explore behaviors. 13. Behavioral contracting involves creating a written agreement that specifies behaviors to be performed, serving as a formal record of commitment witnessed by another person. 14. Assigning homework includes providing tasks related to interventions for individuals to complete at home. 15. An interpersonal focus emphasizes maintaining and improving relationships with others. 16. Behavioral experiments are used to test negative thoughts and re-evaluate underlying beliefs by performing specific actions. 17. Motivational interviewing encourages individuals to make self-motivating statements and evaluate their own behaviors to reduce resistance to change. 18. Direct suggestions involve providing clear instructions on how to act, behave, or handle a situation. 19. Goal setting involves identifying specific aims or objectives to achieve during therapy or a session. 20. Assigning the sick role allows individuals to understand the rights and responsibilities associated with being ill by temporarily adopting the role of a sick person. 21. Empathy is the ability to understand and share another person’s feelings or experiences. 22. Macronutrients are food groups required in large amounts for proper nutrition. 23. Micronutrients are food groups needed in smaller quantities to support health. 24. Eating behaviors refer to the choices and practices related to food consumption. 25. Alcohol use education focuses on promoting minimal alcohol consumption and understanding the harms of misuse. 26. Substance misuse refers to the harmful use of substances for non-medical purposes.
